What Are The Best Upholstery Cleaning Method?

February 05, 2021

Cleaning around the house is of course, one of the most important things you can do to ensure proper sanitation. Mopping floors, wiping the dusts off of counters, and keeping the windows very clean are all easy things to do. What’s not easy though is making sure that your couch and other furniture are clean. Upholstery cleaning is no laughing matter after all.

The main problem with couch and furniture cleaningis that you need to clean deeply. Cleaning deeply is more often than not impossible because you have only so little space to work with. The only way you can clean properly is by simply dismantling your couch which isn’t very easy mind you. People are always on the lookout to find the best couch and chair cleaning methods but not all of them are actually effective.

The good news is that some people have discovered methods which work surprisingly well. Having a clean couch not only makes your house cleaner, but it also makes it better smelling. Let’s not make this any longer. Here are a few upholstery cleaningmethods that you definitely need to check out.

Cleaning The Couch First

Cleaning the couch takes a lot of time mind you. It’s not really ideal to have it deep cleaned especially if there are guests that are going to come by. Even an upholstery cleaning service won’t be able to have the couch cleaned in time before the guests arrive. It sometimes takes days before a couch dries out after cleaning. There are some quick hacks to make sure that your couch gets cleaned fast.

The easiest method is to use a dry brush. The pass-through your couch using a dry brush to loosen up any dirt, solid debris or even loose pieces of fabric. Make sure to brush in one stroke so that you don’t ruin the material of the couch. You don’t need to brush with force too. Just gently pass through the couch with the brush and this can help remove dirt easily.

Alternatively, you can also vacuum your couch on the lowest setting. Like dry brushing, this removes all traces of dirt from your couch. It’s even better to use vacuums with interchangeable nozzles. You’d want to use nozzles that are think enough to go into the crevices of the couch so that you can absorb even those dirt that are already deep within.

If you have extra cushions in your home, that would be much better as you can simply swap cushions when one is being cleaned or when one is dirty. Understandably, not everyone has the extra cushions though. For emergency purposes, you’d want to flip over your cushions instead to make sure that the dirty side stays hidden. It’s a cheap trick but it’s one that works very well.

Of course, these are just basic cleaning tips that you can do for emergency purposes. What if you want a deeper cleaning for your couch? Should you avail an upholstery cleaning serviceimmediately? What if we tell you that there are ways you can clean your couch without having to call for the pros. Here’s how you can deep clean it.

Couch Deep Cleaning For Beginners

Deep cleaning a couch is an integral process which helps you remove the nasty odor eminatting from your furniture. This is the preferred method of course as it is more sanitary than simply brushing your couch. It is also a multi-step process. Overall, this can take you a few hours to do and a day or so to have the couch completely cleaned.

The first thing you’d want to do is check the quality of the couch’s fabric. For this deep cleaning method, you’re going to have to use a cleaning agent which could ruin the feel of some types of fabric. For instance, as baking soda is going to be a key ingredient, you should find and isolate an area, apply baking soda to it, and then check how the fabric reacts. Make sure that the test area is very small and hidden from plain sight.

With that out of the way, the next thing you should do is to brush or vacuum away all of the excess dirt, dust and debris away from the couch. You can do this for the first step. However, you have to brush away the excess baking soda from the couch anyway so might as well have it done in one go. Make sure that you go for the deep crevices too for a deeper clean.

Next, apply baking soda all over your couch. The best way to do this is to wear a glove and then rub it all over your couch. Make sure that not an inch stays safe from the baking soda. Baking soda is an excellent cleaning ingredient that can help do away with nasty odors and excess humidity. Once done, make sure to let it sit for at least 30 minutes. You can mix it with a dry carpet cleaner mix if you want to as well.

The next thing you’d want to do is vacuum the baking soda. If you don’t have a vacuum, you can simply brush away the baking soda out from the couch. Just make sure that you are doing it in an open area so that it’s easier to clean the baking soda that falls. It’s important that you completely clean the baking soda out of your couch.

Next up, you’d want to focus more on cleaning the solid stains on your couch. This is one of the toughest parts of the process. For this, you’d need to make a cleaning solution first. What you’d want to do is mix ¾ cup of warm water, ¼ cup of vinegar and a tablespoon of dish soap of any scent. This mixture works well with fabric upholstery. If you have synthetic upholstery, mix one cup warm water, ½ cup vinegar, and ½ tablespoon of dish soap.

With the mixture made, you simply need to put it in a spray bottle so that you can easily spray it in the affected area. If the stain doesn’t go away after sitting with the solution, you can try wiping it down with a cloth once the solution is sprayed. Your couch can be very wet after this so make sure to dry it completely before you use it.

Call The Pros

Of course, there’s no better cleaning than the one that you’d get when calling the pros. If you don’t have the time and the skill to clean your upholstery, it’s best to have them do the work for your instead. They employ various methods to ensure that your couch is clean inside and out. While the service isn’t free, it’s definitely worth it.

There are various services you can avail from an upholstery cleaning service. For deep cleaning, they’ll not only get rid of the fine dust, they’ll also get rid of the nasty odor in your couch. Deep cleaning also means going deep with the pockets to ensure that there are no dirt that’s hiding from plain sight.

They also offer an upholstery steam cleaning service. In this method, they use steam to clean your couch inside and out. It’s a complicated process that makes use of equipment you don’t normally find at home. If your couch can’t handle steam, then you can try upholstery dry cleaning services instead which is far more efficient than just brushing your couch.

Upholstery cleaning services usually last for an entire day which is not bad as compared to the time you’ll spend when doing your own upholstery cleaning. There are many reasons why you should consider calling the pros for help and their speed at doing the job is only the surface of it.

Your couch gets bacteria and other unwanted contaminants the longer it remains cleaned. These are caused by excess moisture from sweat and even the humidity in the air. When the pros are doing the job for your, they don’t only clean the surface, they also make sure that the insides are free from these harmful contaminants as well.

Another benefit to them is that they are very efficient when it comes to cleaning. What would take you an entire day to do will only last a few hours for them. If you don’t have the time to clean, then their service is something that you’d want to avail on your end.

Last but not the least, these cleaners have access to tools that you don’t normally have at home. These tools provide a deeper clean than anything else.

An upholstery cleaning service does wonders for your furniture. It’s best availed when you have multiple couches or fabric chairs in your home so that you get more bang for your buck. If you want to ensure that your family is safe from bacteria, viruses, and other contaminants, it’s best to ensure that your couch is deeply cleaned at all times.
